result.topic_en: Calculations with Fresnel-type Gaussian integrals and Mellin-type integrals involving Gamma functions (Π), apparently deriving an integral representation related to the functional equation of the zeta function (Riemann–Siegel type computations), with substitution s = ti + 1/2.
result.transcription:
Realer Theil von $i$ zwischen [?] 0 und 1:
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{i(y-x+m\sqrt{\pi})^2}\partial y = \sqrt{\pi}\, e^{+\frac{\pi}{4}i}$
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{i(y+m\sqrt{\pi})^2-2yxi+xxi}\partial y = \sqrt{\pi}\, e^{+\frac{\pi}{4}i}\, e^{+2m\sqrt{\pi}x i}$
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{i(y+m\sqrt{\pi})^2}\int_0^\infty e^{-2yxi+xxi} x^{s-1}\partial x = \sqrt{\pi}\, e^{+\frac{\pi}{4}i}\int_0^\infty e^{2m\sqrt{\pi}xi} x^{s-1}\partial x = \sqrt{\pi}\, e^{+\frac{\pi}{4}i}\frac{\Pi(s-1)}{(-2m\sqrt{\pi}i)^s} = \frac{e^{\frac{\pi}{4}i}\, 2^{s-1}\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\Pi\frac{s-1}{2}}{(-2m\sqrt{\pi}i)^s}$
$= \frac{1}{2}\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\Pi(\frac{s-1}{2})\pi^{-\frac{s}{2}}m^{-s}i^{s+\frac{1}{2}}$
$\int_0^\infty e^{-2yxi+xxi}x^{s-1}\partial x = \sum\int_0^\infty e^{xxi}(-2yi)^n\frac{x^{n+s-1}}{n!}\partial x = \frac{1}{2}\sum\frac{(-2yi)^n}{n!}\Pi(\frac{n+s}{2}-1)\, i^{\frac{n+s}{2}}$
$= \frac{1}{2}e^{-\frac{1}{2}yyi}\left(\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)u\, i^{\frac{s}{2}} + \Pi(\frac{s-1}{2})\, i^{\frac{s+1}{2}}u'\right)$
53
$\frac{2^s\Pi\frac{s}{2}\cdot\Pi\frac{s-1}{2}}{\Pi s} = \frac{(2\pi)^{\frac12}}{\sqrt{2}} = \sqrt{\pi}$
$= \frac{2^{s-1}\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\Pi\frac{s-1}{2}}{\Pi(s-1)}$
$\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\pi^{-\frac{s}{2}}n^{-s} = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{i(y+n\sqrt{\pi})^2-\frac{1}{2}yyi}\left(\frac{\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)}{\Pi\frac{s-1}{2}}u\, i^{-\frac{s}{2}+\frac12} + i^{-\frac{s}{2}}u'\right)\partial y$
$\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\Pi(-\frac{s}{2}) = \frac{\pi}{\sin\frac{s}{2}\pi}$
$\Pi(\frac{s-1}{2})(\frac{-s-1}{2}) = \frac{\pi}{\sin\frac{s+1}{2}\pi}$
$\pi\cdot \quad = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{i(y+n\sqrt{\pi})^2-\frac12 yyi}\left(i^{-\frac{s}{2}}u' + u\, i^{-\frac{s}{2}+\frac12}\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\Pi(\frac{-s-1}{2})\frac{\cos\frac{s}{2}\pi}{\pi}\right)\partial y$
$\frac{i^{\frac{s}{2}+\frac12}+i^{-\frac{3s}{2}+\frac12}}{\pi}$
$\Pi(\frac{1-s}{2}-1)\pi^{-\frac{1-s}{2}}n^{[-s-1-]}i^{[-s-1-]} = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-i(y+n\sqrt{\pi})^2+\frac12 yyi}\, i\left(i^{-\frac{1-s}{2}-1}u' + u\, i^{\frac{s}{2}+1}\Pi\frac{-s-1}{2}\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\frac{\sin\frac{s}{2}\pi}{\pi}\right)$
$\Pi(\frac{1-s}{2}-1)n^{-\frac{1-s}{2}}n^{s-1} = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-i(y+n\sqrt{\pi})^2+\frac12 yyi}\left(i^{\frac{-s-3}{2}}u' + u\, i^{-\frac{s}{2}+2}\pi^{\frac{-s-1}{2}}\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\frac{\sin\frac{s}{2}\pi}{\pi}\right)$
$\frac{i^{s-1}+i^{-s+1}}{2} \quad \frac{i^{\frac{s}{2}+1}+i^{-\frac{3s}{2}-1}}{2}$
$s = ti+\frac12$ [-$e^{-\frac{\pi}{8}i}$-]
$u' e^{\frac14\pi t}e^{-\frac{\pi}{8}i} + u\left(e^{-\frac14\pi t}e^{\frac{3\pi}{8}i} + e^{\frac34\pi t}e^{-\frac18\pi i}\right)\pi^{\frac{-s-1}{2}}\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\frac{1}{2\pi}$
$u' e^{\frac14\pi t}e^{-\frac78\pi i} + u\left(e^{-\frac14\pi t}e^{\frac58\pi i} + e^{\frac34\pi t}e^{-\frac78\pi i}\right)\pi^{\frac{s-1}{2}}\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\frac{1}{2\pi}$
$= \int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\sin((y+n\sqrt{\pi})^2-\frac12 yy-\frac{\pi}{8})\left(u' e^{\frac14\pi t} + u\, e^{\frac34\pi t}\Pi(\frac{s-1}{2})\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\frac{1}{\pi}\right) + \sin((y+n\sqrt{\pi})^2-\frac12 yy+\frac38\pi)\, u\, \pi^{\frac{s-1}{2}}\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)\frac{1}{\pi}e^{-\frac14\pi t}\Big)$
$(-1)^n\sin(\frac12(y+2n\sqrt{\pi})^2-\frac{\pi}{8})$
$(-1)^n\sin(\frac12(y+2n\sqrt{\pi})^2+\frac38\pi)$
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-i(y-x+m\sqrt{\pi})^2}\partial y = \sqrt{\pi}\, e^{-\frac{\pi}{4}i}$, $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-i(y+m\sqrt{\pi})^2}\int_0^\infty e^{2yxi-xxi}x^{-s}\partial x\,\partial y = \int_0^\infty e^{-2m\sqrt{\pi}xi}x^{-s}\partial x\sqrt{\pi}\, e^{-\frac{\pi}{4}i} = \frac{\Pi(-s)}{(2m\sqrt{\pi}i)^{1-s}}\sqrt{\pi}\, e^{-\frac{\pi}{4}i}$
$= \frac12\Pi\frac{-s-1}{2}\Pi(-\frac{s}{2})\pi^{\frac{1-s}{2}}m^{1-s}i^{s-\frac32}$
$\int_0^\infty e^{2yxi-xxi}x^{-s}\partial x = \frac12\sum\frac{(2yi)^n}{n!}\frac{\Pi\frac{n-s-1}{2}}{i^{\frac{n-s+1}{2}}} = \frac12 e^{\frac12 yyi}\left(u\,\Pi\frac{-s-1}{2}i^{\frac{s-1}{2}} + u'\,\Pi(\frac{-s}{2})\, i^{\frac{s}{2}+1}\right)$

methods.what: Mellin transform of an oscillatory exponential giving Gamma function
Series expansion of Mellin integral of exp(-2yxi+xxi) in powers of y, expressed via functions u, u'
Simplification of the exponent using parity of n
